prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, wide-angle shot of the open trunk of a car, filled with several large, bright blue reusable shopping bags prominently displaying the Walmart logo and slogan in bold white letters. The bags are neatly arranged, their crisp fabric and structured shape suggesting they are full of groceries or goods. The background is softly blurred, focusing attention on the bags, while the interior of the car is dimly lit, creating a subtle contrast with the vivid blue of the bags. The lighting is natural and even, suggesting daylight, with soft shadows adding depth. The overall style is clean, commercial, and modern, evoking a sense of organization and eco-conscious shopping. The composition is straightforward and symmetrical, emphasizing the branding and the practical, everyday context of a shopping trip.
